The '''SE-14C''' was a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] produced by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It was an upgraded model of the basic BlasTech [[SE-14 blaster pistol]].

The SE-14C featured top-mounted optical and infrared targeting scopes, and a barrel containing both a [[Power cell/Legends|power pack]] and a recharge valve. The SE-14C could also be used as an automatic weapon, and featured a rapid-fire auto trigger.

[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Cornelius Evazan/Legends|Cornelius Evazan]] used this pistol when he threatened [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]]. [[BoShek/Legends|BoShek]] and [[Ponda Baba/Legends|Ponda Baba]] were also known to use the SE-14C.

==Behind the scenes==
Like the [[SE-14 blaster pistol]], the SE-14C prop was created from a cut-down Swiss Rexim-Favor submachine gun. To produce the prop, the stock, barrel, and magazine were removed, and two ASI 4x20 scopes were added.
